title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: part:350011 – price adjustment from 01 January 2027, our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer for the 7.5 kW motor. We value our long partnership and want a stable and sustainable agreement for 2027.

Our forecast fc:350011@2026-09 records a volume change of 11.9 %, which gives you a growing and reliable base load.

We attach two complete packages for 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months. One offers longer payment days, which ease your financing at no cost to your margin. As the requested change exceeds 2 %, could you please submit our proposal to your pricing committee for review?

We would also welcome any cheaper motor variant or design option you can suggest.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: part:350011 – price adjustment from 01 January 2027, our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your updated volume forecast and incorporated the resulting economies of scale into our revised offer. Our engineering department will evaluate your request for alternative motor variants and contact you shortly. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Ourangebot provides a price of €359.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.
